## Platform engineering, Vandelay Industries, 2021-2024

Senior Platform Engineer. Built and operated the internal developer platform for ~40 engineering
teams: a self-service deploy pipeline, a shared observability stack, and a Kubernetes-based service
mesh rollout. Owned the platform's on-call rotation for 18 months. Individually responsible for the
platform's core services — no team management in this role.

## Tech lead, 3-person team, 2023

For a 6-month stretch in 2023, informally led a 3-person sub-team inside the Vandelay platform org
to ship the observability stack above: assigned work, ran the team's planning, unblocked the other
two engineers. Not a formal management title, and the team was 3 people, not a full platform
organization.

## Payments-adjacent e-commerce integrations, Initech, 2018-2021

Backend engineer at Initech, an e-commerce checkout provider. Built integrations between the
checkout flow and several third-party payment processors (Stripe, Adyen). Handled PCI-scope code
review for these integrations. This work touched payment processing but never fintech regulatory
compliance, AML/KYC tooling, or banking-license-adjacent systems — that is a different, adjacent
domain this evidence does not cover.

## Engineering team lead, Acme Corp, 2016-2018

Led a 4-person backend team at Acme Corp for one year: hiring, 1:1s, sprint planning, and technical
direction for the team's services. This is the only evidence of formal team leadership /
people-management experience in this history, and it ended in 2018 — well before the 2018-2021
Initech role below starts, no overlap.

## Core languages and tooling

TypeScript and Python, daily use across all roles above (2018-2024). No Go, no Rust. Comfortable with
Kubernetes as a platform *user* and *operator* (the 2021-2024 role); no experience authoring
